content.comment_body: Hello, I am using a [product_name] with [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no]. When I try to upload my program to the device, nothing happens. I cannot see the device on the network when scanning. My network configuration is: IP address: [hidden], Subnet mask: [hidden], Gateway: [hidden]. The device is directly connected with an Ethernet cable. My PC uses the same subnet mask and gateway, and a different IP address. Ping tests are successful both ways, but when using [product_name] Soft Comfort to scan the network, the device is not found. If I 'Go online', the connection appears set, but actions like uploading or switching to run mode don't work. Can anyone help identify my mistake? Thanks for your help.

Welcome to the forum. If your PC and [product_name] are on the same subnet, you don’t need to set a gateway address. Are you sure you’ve selected the correct network adapter in the configuration? Also, is your [product_name] Soft Comfort a full version or demo version? Which [product_name] model do you have? Please provide the exact order number and firmware version.
Hello, You should install Update [version_no] – [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no] SP1.
If it’s a demo version, upgrading may not be possible. If the device is a [product_name] standard version, an update might not be needed. Let’s wait for the topic starter to respond.
Hello [user_name], Yes, that's correct. Most users facing this problem need to address software updates.
You can also recommend updating the firmware whenever possible.
I verified and selected the correct 'Ethernet' adapter. My version is not a demo (although I started in demo mode, I switched to the full version). My device has reference [article_no].

Your device is the latest [product_name] version [version_no]. In device selection, it’s referred to as [product_name] [version_no]. For this model, you need at least [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no], but for full functionality, [version_no] or newer is recommended. The upgrade to [version_no] is free if you have the full version. Download the package (about 1.3 GB) and run setup as an administrator.
Applying the update allowed me to connect and transfer my program. Thank you for your assistance!
Does updating the system cause any issues?
Check the previous post for more information.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered trouble connecting [product_name] Soft Comfort with [product_name] hardware, despite working Ethernet and ping tests. The issue was a mismatch between the hardware version and the software version, with newer devices requiring updated software. User experience and connectivity depended on matching software versions to the correct hardware and understanding differences between demo and full versions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect simple network discovery and seamless upload/download between [product_name] Soft Comfort and [product_name] hardware when network connectivity is established. They assume software compatibility should be ensured or flagged automatically by the system.
